the_signal.headline: Task-based access control replaces static RBAC for agentic systems
the_signal.body: n8n's latest research shows traditional role-based access control breaks when agents make dynamic decisions across resources. GTM teams deploying revenue automation need task-based rules—permissions tied to what the agent is *doing* in a workflow, not who owns it. This is the compliance gap between your current infrastructure and production-grade agent systems.

thread_of_day.title: Long-running agents need loop engineering, not just prompt engineering
thread_of_day.takeaway: Agents sustaining multi-step revenue workflows fail when you rely on LLM instructions alone; you need deterministic state loops and context resets to keep them factual across 100+ step sequences

quote.text: Y'all relying too much on prompting your way through agent design. Call it context engineering or loop engineering, you still ask the LLM to make sure it only generates factual information.
quote.source: n8n Blog — Long-running agents beyond prompt engineering
